nome: Cambridge English YLE Starters - Revisão Completa
title: Preparação Completa para Cambridge English YLE Starters
description: Lista abrangente com mais de 100 exercícios cobrindo todos os tópicos necessários para o exame Cambridge English YLE Starters (Pre A1). Inclui vocabulário, gramática, animais, família, cores, números, partes do corpo e muito mais.

exercises.question: What color is the sun?
exercises.explicacao: The sun is yellow. O sol é amarelo.
exercises.dica: Think about what you see in the sky during the day.

exercises.question: How many legs does a cat have?
exercises.explicacao: A cat has four legs. Um gato tem quatro pernas.
exercises.dica: Count the legs of animals you see every day.

exercises.question: My mother's mother is my _______.
exercises.explicacao: Your mother's mother is your grandmother. A mãe da sua mãe é sua avó.
exercises.dica: Think about family relationships.

exercises.question: I brush my _______ every morning.
exercises.explicacao: We brush our teeth every morning. Escovamos os dentes toda manhã.
exercises.dica: What do you clean in your mouth?

exercises.question: What do you use to write?
exercises.explicacao: We use a pencil to write. Usamos um lápis para escrever.
exercises.dica: What school supply helps you write?

exercises.question: True or False: A dog is an animal.
exercises.explicacao: True. A dog is an animal. Verdadeiro. Um cachorro é um animal.
exercises.dica: Think about what category dogs belong to.

exercises.question: What number comes after five?
exercises.explicacao: Six comes after five. Seis vem depois de cinco.

exercises.question: Where do you sleep?

exercises.explicacao: We use a spoon to eat soup. Usamos uma colher para comer sopa.

exercises.question: True or False: Fish can swim.
exercises.explicacao: True. Fish can swim. Verdadeiro. Peixes podem nadar.
exercises.dica: Think about where fish live.

exercises.question: What color do you get when you mix red and yellow?

exercises.question: We use our _______ to see.

exercises.question: What do you wear on your feet?
